name: 和風
css: .roulette-wrapper { width: 480px !important; height: 480px !important; position: absolute !important; top: 300px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); margin: 0 !important; }

.outer-frame { position: absolute; top: 300px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 520px; height: 520px; border-radius: 50%; background: linear-gradient(45deg, #8b4513 0%, #a0522d 50%, #8b4513 100%); box-shadow: 0 0 0 8px #dcb464, 0 0 0 12px #8b4513, 0 0 60px rgba(220, 180, 100, 0.3), inset 0 0 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); pointer-events: none; }

.inner-decoration { position: absolute; top: 300px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 500px; height: 500px; border-radius: 50%; border: 3px solid #dcb464; box-shadow: inset 0 0 20px rgba(220, 180, 100, 0.3), 0 0 20px rgba(220, 180, 100, 0.2); pointer-events: none; }
#roulette-svg-target { border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle, #2a1810 0%, #1a0f0a 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 0 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); }
.center-mon { position: absolute; top: 300px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 120px; height: 120px; z-index: 10; pointer-events: none; }

.mon-outer { position: absolute; width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: 50%; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #8b4513, #a0522d); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #dcb464, 0 0 30px rgba(220, 180, 100, 0.5), inset 0 0 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); }

.mon-inner { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 85%; height: 85%; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle, #2a1810 0%, #1a0f0a 100%); border: 2px solid #dcb464; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; box-shadow: inset 0 0 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8); }
.mon-symbol { font-size: 48px; color: #dcb464; text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(220, 180, 100, 0.8); animation: mon-glow 3s ease-in-out infinite; }

.pointer { position: absolute; top: 45px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: 0; height: 0; border-left: 25px solid transparent; border-right: 25px solid transparent; border-top: 45px solid #c41e3a; filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 8px rgba(196, 30, 58, 0.6)); z-index: 20; pointer-events: none; }

.pointer::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -45px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: 12px; height: 12px; background: #dcb464; border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(220, 180, 100, 0.8); }

#spinBtn { display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; width: 240px; height: 80px; font-size: 28px; font-weight: bold; color: #ffffff; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #8b4513 0%, #a0522d 50%, #8b4513 100%); border: 3px solid #dcb464; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 6px 0 #5a2d0f, 0 8px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(220, 180, 100, 0.3); transition: all 0.2s ease; letter-spacing: 8px; font-family: 'Yu Mincho', serif; position: absolute; top: 570px; }
#result { font-size: 36px; font-weight: bold; color: #dcb464; text-shadow: 0 0 20px #dcb464; font-family: 'Yu Mincho', serif; position: absolute; top: 650px; width: 100%; text-align: center; }

#legend-area { top: 570px !important; right: 20px !important; width: 160px !important; max-height: 150px !important; background: rgba(40, 20, 10, 0.9) !important; border: 2px solid #dcb464 !important; color: #dcb464 !important; }
